name: Military Occupational Specialty — 25U Signal Support
description: Awarded upon successful completion of MOS 25U training and 4 years of active service.

achievement.name: MOS 25U — Signal Support Systems Specialist
achievement.description: Installs, operates, and maintains radio and data distribution systems. Translates to civilian IT and network technician roles.

criteria.narrative: Completed Advanced Individual Training at Fort Gordon, maintained SECRET clearance, deployed and operated tactical communication networks in field environments.
